author_revision_plan.frequency_dependence: Firstly, the fitness of WS is frequency-dependent and thus a mutant’s selection coefficient is very different at the time it originates compared to when it is established at the air-liquid interface
author_revision_plan.other_competitors: Secondly, the selection coefficient is also dependent on the frequency of other WS types and other phenotypes selected at the air-liquid interface
author_revision_plan.assay_reference: Thirdly, fitness in our study is measured against a _wspF_ (WS) mutant and not the wild type ancestor, which is needed for use in origin-fixation models.

author_final_revision.title_scope: our previous title gave the unintended message that we were combining mutation and selection into our model of evolutionary forecasting.
author_final_revision.forecast_scope: we do not attempt to predict the outcome of experimental evolution using mutation rates and selection coefficients.
author_final_revision.fitness_assay_purpose: We have provided a better motivation for the fitness assays, which is to provide an explanation for these differences.
author_final_revision.reporting_additions: We have included statistical tests for all claims of differences as well as number of replicates.

reviewer_suggestion.eye_estimation_sentence: Here x is the selection coefficient of the WspF control used in growth competitions, and I have estimated s by eye from Figure 6.
